consent.intro: Record a voice note in your language; the person you send it to hears it in theirs, spoken in your own voice.
consent.title: Cloning your voice
consent.point_provider: Your recordings are sent to ElevenLabs, our speech provider, to build the clone.
consent.point_voiceprint: A voiceprint is created from them. Under the GDPR that is biometric data about you.
consent.point_languages: The clone can speak languages you have never spoken.
consent.point_own_voice: Only your own recordings are ever kept — never the other person’s.
consent.point_revocable: You can delete the voice at any time. Voice notes work without it, in a standard voice.
consent.checkbox: I agree to my voice being processed to create a voice clone.
consent.optional_note: Optional. Without it your notes are spoken in a neutral standard voice.
consent.collecting_hint: Recordings of at least 5 seconds count. They are deleted once the clone is finished.
consent.clone_refined: Your voice clone is finished and the samples have been deleted
consent.clone_built_from: Built from {seconds} seconds of your speech
consent.delete_message: The voice is deleted at the provider and here, the samples go with it, and collection stops. Notes you already sent keep their audio. You can opt in again later.

live.title: Face to face
live.subtitle: One phone between two people. They need no account.
live.hint: Nothing is saved — only the minutes are counted.
